name: wht_4p2m
label: William Herschel Telescope 4.2 m
sources: ING WHT optics page (ing.iac.es/PR/wht_info/whtoptics.html): clear aperture 4.2 m, central obstruction 1.21 m (secondary 1.0 m); effective focal length 46.2 m (f/11) at Cassegrain and Nasmyth.
ING (ing.iac.es): 4.2 m primary, collecting area 13.8 m^2 (Wikipedia); position 28 45 38.3 N, 17 52 53.9 W, 2332 m ground floor (GPS 1993, ING Observers' Guide 1994 1.2)
notes: collecting_area_m2 = pi/4 (4.2^2 - 1.21^2) = 12.70 m^2 removes the 1.21 m central obstruction (the unobstructed disk is 13.85 m^2; the earlier 13.8 m^2 was that disk).

Throughput 0.3 (atmosphere + telescope optics to the camera, excl. filter and PDE) is the hbtsim default, not an LPQI number; Prada et al. 2026 (ELTI) adopt an overall instrumental efficiency of 0.5 for a SPAD camera at the focus.
